titleStmt.title: List of subscribers to the fund for the relief of the yellow fever sufferers in the United States.

head.hi: List of subscribers to the fund for the relief of the yellow fever sufferers in the United States.

div.p: United States legation: M. Boquet (de l’Eure), 5 francs; A. B. Mauritz, 20 francs; Adolph H. Reitlinger, 500 francs; M. Ferdinand Duval (prefect of the Seine), 300 francs; Dr. Wm. E. Johnston, 50 francs; B. Berend, 500 francs; G. Saisme d’Hauterive, 10 francs; M. de Warrechin, 20 francs; A. H. Reitlinger &, Co., 500 francs; M. Edward Delano, 100 francs; Mr. Waddington (minister of foreign affairs), 500 francs; A. Hutchinson & Co., 500 francs; Mr. Mollet (d’Orleans), 5 francs; Messrs. Woodman & Co., 60 francs; Grand Orient de France, 1,000 francs; M. le General Borel (minister of war), 500 francs; M. le Préfect des Deux Sevres, 50 francs; cash, 500 francs; Oscar de Lafayette, 500 francs; M. de Marcére (minister of the interior), 300 francs; M’me Vve. Gilly, 20 francs; G. P. Harding, 1,000 francs; M. Leon Say (minister of finances), 300 francs; Frederick Grand d’Hauteville, 500 francs, John T. Lord, 100 francs; M. le Due de Némours, 500 francs; A. Army officer who died of yellow fever (her three-months’ pension, £10 4s., netting 257.30 francs; M. le Prince de Chalais, 500 francs; M. Gustave Honegger, 20 francs; Jacques Schupp, 20 francs.

Collected through the United States commissioner-general, Paris Exhibition: B. Berend, jr., 100 francs; Dr. W. H. Reever, 125 francs; R. A. C. Doran, U. S. N., 100 francs; A. H. Collected through Continental Gazette: Pons, 20 francs; Dr. E. B. Lond, 100 francs; Henry Upham, 40 francs; N. N., 20 francs; cash, 500 francs.
